phenomenon_scale.note: Cell-contact Turing wavelength. Not the ~1 mm adult bar spacing of the organ-scale sibling.

equations.kinetics: u_t = A - u + u^2 v + div(D_u grad u); v_t = B - u^2 v + div(D_v grad v)
equations.k_c: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)

chronoseries_contrast.aesculapii: R=28 > R_c; dorsal vertical bars; ventral anisotropy collapse breaks bars into spots
chronoseries_contrast.albolineatus: same Du, R=1.20 < R_c; diffusion-weighted trace negative; 20.8 µm mode does not amplify
chronoseries_contrast.not_the_sibling: models/2018-spiewak-danio-aesculapii-turing-wavelength.py is the 1.009 mm organ-scale slot and is not reused

empirical_claims: Kullander & Fang 2009 named D. aesculapii from south-western Myanmar and figured vertical bars.
Spiewak et al. 2018 tie Danio pigment diversification, including barred versus reduced patterns, to endothelin signalling.

Nakamasu et al. 2009 and Yamanaka & Kondo 2014 show melanophore-xanthophore contact can select a Turing wavelength. The 21 µm assignment is this loop's cellular detail scale, not a quoted aesculapii measurement of 21.0 µm.
The primary photograph shows a lateral fish with vertical flank bars on a dark field. Body circularity and aspect are measured in the script and are not equal to a circle.
boundary_conditions: Periodic spectral diffusion on the cellular grid. The whole-animal render is masked to the photographed silhouette; the exterior is the untouched photograph.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952 dispersion relation and critical-wavenumber formula
Nakamasu 2009 / Yamanaka & Kondo 2014 cell-contact Turing interactions between melanophores and xanthophores
Kullander & Fang 2009 species diagnosis with vertical bars
Spiewak et al. 2018 endothelin-linked diversification of Danio pigment patterns
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg parameters A=0.14, B=0.98, R=28 chosen so λ_c = 2.08e-05 m
Dorsal anisotropy versus ventral isotropy as the vertical-bar transition
does_not_claim: That a paper measured λ = 21.0 µm on D. aesculapii
That adult whole-body bars are one cellular wavelength apart
That the silhouette composite is a pixel copy of the photograph
